title: Sum of Even Numbers
statement: Write a function `sumOfEvens(numbers)` that returns the sum of all even numbers in an array. Use a loop.
prewrittenHints: Iterate through the array elements with a loop.
Test each element with modulo two to see if it is even.
Add the even elements into your running total.
conceptNote: Arrays store multiple items in order. Access items by index starting at 0 up to length - 1.
